normalized.description:
CNES-CSG intends to renew its infrared cameras that follows the rockets after launching during a few minutes.

Currently, we are using MWIR cameras that are now obsolete and don't fulfill all requirements.
Recent tests have shown that LWIR cameras are more suitable.

The camera system must include image recording.

The purpose of the project is to:
•	Supply the cameras
•	Interface them with our turrets, and with the operational displays
•	Define the right parameters to optimize images

ОП № 2: Застраховка „Гражданска отговорност на автомобилистите“ - осигурява застрахователно покритие на имуществени вреди, причинени от трети лица, в т.ч. пешеходци, велосипедисти и други участници в движението по пътищата от пътни превозни средства на Агенция по геодезия, картография и кадастър (АГКК) и Застраховката „Злополука на местата в МПС“- осигурява застрахователно покритие на вреди за здравето на водача и пътниците в пътните превозни средства на АГКК на 53 броя МПС. Exploitation Platforms are a central element of ESA's Earth Observation (EO) Innovation Europe concept, which aims at the integration of EO data and information for a much broader use, for scientific, social and economic purposes, as well as for the generation of new commercial applications and services. 

The EO NoR initiative promotes the use of European resource and platform services to facilitate a simplified and efficient exploitation of EO data in cloud environments. The initiative incentivizes providers to contribute to a common framework harmonising the access to their services and helping the user to work with the data.
